brief:
Doctors who volunteered in Gaza have described harrowing conditions in hospitals ravaged by Israel's ongoing military campaign, Al Jazeera English reported. The medical professionals recounted working amid severe shortages of supplies, damaged infrastructure, and overwhelming patient loads as the conflict continues across the strip.

Hospitals across Gaza are struggling to provide basic care, facing widespread destruction and severe resource scarcity as the war persists.
dek: Doctors who volunteered in Gaza have described working during Israel’s genocidal war on the strip.
title: Volunteer doctors detail hospital devastation during Israel's Gaza war
